findings.title: Wall-clock sleep makes cache TTL test timing-sensitive and flaky under CI load
findings.suggested_fix: Replace real-time wait (`setTimeout(20)`) with fake timers (`vi.useFakeTimers`/`vi.advanceTimersByTime`) or inject a clock into the cache service so TTL transition is deterministic.

findings.title: Queue-wait metric test depends on real sleep duration and scheduler timing
findings.suggested_fix: Remove `sleep(35)`-driven behavior; instead mock or inject time/queue wait signal directly and assert metric computation from controlled inputs.

findings.title: Test name claims datasource boundary validation but assertions only verify health metrics
findings.suggested_fix: Add explicit retrieval assertions per datasource (e.g., each retrieval returns only its own seeded chunks/index version) and include a negative assertion that foreign datasource chunks are absent.

findings.title: New rerank routing/parser paths lack dedicated negative-path tests
findings.suggested_fix: Add focused unit tests for `rerankCandidates` and parser behavior: empty candidates short-circuit, invalid/non-JSON model response fallback, fenced JSON extraction, score clamping, and missing `candidateId` row filtering.

residual_risks: Several integration specs still use shared sqlite path (`data/sqlite/text2sql.db`) instead of isolated fixtures, which can leak state across runs and raise order-dependence risk.
RAG orchestration quality checks focus heavily on aggregate metrics; without stronger per-datasource output assertions, cross-tenant leakage regressions could pass silently.
testing_gaps: No direct tests for `RagDatasourceQuotaPolicy` decision matrix boundaries (global/workspace concurrency edge values and circuit-open precedence).
No dedicated frontend unit coverage for `assistant-thread.tsx` and `sql-inline-panel.tsx` updates in this branch; regressions may only surface in broad chat flow tests.
Provider router rerank parser fallback behavior is untested against malformed/partial model payloads.
